title: Dasakam 14 – Kapilavatara
description: Manu's devotion, Kardama's austerities and family, and Kapila's birth and teaching.

stanzas.sanskrit:
समनुस्मृततावकाङ्घ्रियुग्मः
स मनुः पङ्कजसम्भवाङ्गजन्मा ।
निजमन्तरमन्तरायहीनं
चरितं ते कथयन् सुखं निनाय ॥ १४-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
samanusmṛtatāvakāṅghriyugmaḥ
sa manuḥ paṅkajasambhavāṅgajanmā |
nijamantaramantarāyahīnaṃ
caritaṃ te kathayan sukhaṃ nināya || 14-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: After the Lord's Varaha incarnation, Brahma's son, Swayambhu Manu spent his life span peacefully without any trouble, always immersed in deep devotion to Bhagwan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
समये खलु तत्र कर्दमाख्यो
द्रुहिणच्छायभवस्तदीयवाचा ।
धृतसर्गरसो निसर्गरम्यं
भगवंस्त्वामयुतं समाः सिषेवे ॥ १४-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
samaye khalu tatra kardamākhyo
druhiṇacchāyabhavastadīyavācā |
dhṛtasargaraso nisargaramyaṃ
bhagavaṃstvāmayutaṃ samāḥ siṣeve || 14-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: During that time, Prajapati Kardama, born from Brahma's own shadow, worshipped Lord Narayana for ten thousand years, awaiting to take up the work of 'creation' of the species, as instructed by Lord Brahma.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गरुडोपरि कालमेघकम्रं
विलसत्केलिसरोजपाणिपद्मम् ।
हसितोल्लसिताननं विभो त्वं
वपुराविष्कुरुषे स्म कर्दमाय ॥ १४-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
garuḍopari kālameghakamraṃ
vilasatkelisarojapāṇipadmam |
hasitollasitānanaṃ vibho tvaṃ
vapurāviṣkuruṣe sma kardamāya || 14-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Narayana appeared before Kardama, seated on the divine Garuda, as beautiful as a dark rain-bearing cloud, holding a lustrous lotus with a smiling face.

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्तुवते पुलकावृताय तस्मै
मनुपुत्रीं दयितां नवापि पुत्रीः ।
कपिलं च सुतं स्वमेव पश्चात्
स्वगतिं चाप्यनुगृह्य निर्गतोऽभूः ॥ १४-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
stuvate pulakāvṛtāya tasmai
manuputrīṃ dayitāṃ navāpi putrīḥ |
kapilaṃ ca sutaṃ svameva paścāt
svagatiṃ cāpyanugṛhya nirgato’bhūḥ || 14-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan blessed him to marry Devahuti, daughter of Manu and said that couple would have nine daughters. Bhagwan HIMSELF would thereafter, be born to him as the tenth child with the name, KAPILA. Thereafter Bhagwan promised "Moksha" to Kardama.

stanzas.sanskrit:
स मनुः शतरूपया महिष्या
गुणवत्या सुतया च देवहूत्या ।
भवदीरितनारदोपदिष्टः
समगात् कर्दममागतिप्रतीक्षम् ॥ १४-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sa manuḥ śatarūpayā mahiṣyā
guṇavatyā sutayā ca devahūtyā |
bhavadīritanāradopadiṣṭaḥ
samagāt kardamamāgatipratīkṣam || 14-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Manu along with his queen wife Shatarupa and the virtuous daughter Devahuti, as advised by Naradha, who was prompted by Bhagwan, approached Kardama who was awaiting their arrival.

stanzas.sanskrit:
मनुनोपहृतां च देवहूतिं
तरुणीरत्नमवाप्य कर्दमोऽसौ ।
भवदर्चननिर्वृतोऽपि तस्यां
दृढशुश्रूषणया दधौ प्रसादम् ॥ १४-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
manunopahṛtāṃ ca devahūtiṃ
taruṇīratnamavāpya kardamo’sau |
bhavadarcananirvṛto’pi tasyāṃ
dṛḍhaśuśrūṣaṇayā dadhau prasādam || 14-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Manu got his daughter Devahuti married to Kardama, who was a gem among women. Kardama, though solely delighted in worshipping Bhagwan, was pleased with her by her dedicated service to him.

stanzas.sanskrit:
स पुनस्त्वदुपासनप्रभावा-
-द्दयिताकामकृते कृते विमाने ।
वनिताकुलसङ्कुलो नवात्मा
व्यहरद्देवपथेषु देवहूत्या ॥ १४-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sa punastvadupāsanaprabhāvā-
-ddayitākāmakṛte kṛte vimāne |
vanitākulasaṅkulo navātmā
vyaharaddevapatheṣu devahūtyā || 14-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Thereafter Kardama by worshipping Bhagwan, to fulfill the desires of his loving wife, took on a new body, got an aerial vehicle made & with many attendants sported in the garden of the Gods along with Devahuti.

stanzas.sanskrit:
शतवर्षमथ व्यतीत्य सोऽयं
नव कन्याः समवाप्य धन्यरूपाः ।
वनयानसमुद्यतोऽपि कान्ता-
-हितकृत् त्वज्जननोत्सुको न्यवात्सीत् ॥ १४-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śatavarṣamatha vyatītya so’yaṃ
nava kanyāḥ samavāpya dhanyarūpāḥ |
vanayānasamudyato’pi kāntā-
-hitakṛt tvajjananotsuko nyavātsīt || 14-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: After spending a hundred years thus and begetting nine beautiful daughters, Kardama wanted to take up the ascetic life and retire to the forest. As per his wife's wishes and eagerly awaiting Bhagwan’s birth as their son, he continued to stay on at home.

stanzas.sanskrit:
निजभर्तृगिरा भवन्निषेवा-
-निरतायामथ देव देवहूत्याम् ।
कपिलस्त्वमजायथा जनानां
प्रथयिष्यन् परमात्मतत्त्वविद्याम् ॥ १४-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nijabhartṛgirā bhavanniṣevā-
-niratāyāmatha deva devahūtyām |
kapilastvamajāyathā janānāṃ
prathayiṣyan paramātmatattvavidyām || 14-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Devahuti who, on the advise of her husband was always engaged in worshipping Bhagwan. Bhagwan HIMSELF were born as Kapila in order to teach mankind the means for the attainment of the Supreme Reality.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वनमेयुषि कर्दमे प्रसन्ने
मतसर्वस्वमुपादिशन् जनन्यै ।
कपिलात्मक वायुमन्दिरेश
त्वरितं त्वं परिपाहि मां गदौघात् ॥ १४-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vanameyuṣi kardame prasanne
matasarvasvamupādiśan jananyai |
kapilātmaka vāyumandireśa
tvaritaṃ tvaṃ paripāhi māṃ gadaughāt || 14-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: After Kapila was born, Kardama retired to forest to perform penance. Kapila became a great philosopher and taught the essence of his teachings to his own mother, Devahuti. Bhattathiri requested Bhagwan to cure him from his illness.
